name: Legacy Fishing Charters
summary: Private deep sea fishing charters from the Careenage in Bridgetown on a 40 foot Viking sportfisher, run by Captain Jono Jones, who was raised in Barbados and raced as a professional jockey before founding the business. Choose 4, 6 or 8 hours, or a tournament package, with gear, bait, drinks and fish cleaning included. The fishing grounds on the drop-off are 10 to 15 minutes from the harbour.
standouts: Private charters only, no shared trips
40 foot Viking sportfisher with flybridge, air-conditioned cabin, restroom and fighting chair
Shimano and Penn tackle, with all bait, gear and licences included
Catch cleaned and filleted on return

contact.address: The Careenage, Bridgetown, St. Michael, Barbados

trips.title: 4 Hour Fishing Charter
trips.summary: A short private charter for first-time anglers, families, cruise ship guests or anyone with limited time. The crew handles the gear and bait and cleans the catch at the end.
highlights: Targets wahoo, barracuda, tuna and mahi-mahi
Captain Jono and a first mate on board
Round-trip transport available for an extra fee
includes: Complimentary drinks: beer, rum punch, sodas, bottled water
trips.checkNotes: No prices on the site. The Book Now page is a booking request form; the site says confirmation follows. Departure listed as 'Flexible start times'. What-to-bring list and year-round season are from the FAQ page.

trips.title: 6 Hour Fishing Trip
trips.summary: A longer private charter for keen anglers who want more time to chase bigger fish, with live bait and outriggers. Sandwiches are served and there is a chance to swim or snorkel partway through if the weather allows.
highlights: Targets wahoo, mahi-mahi, tuna and sailfish
Swim or snorkel stop, weather permitting
includes: Complimentary drinks: rum punch, beer, soft drinks, water
trips.checkNotes: The trip block says 'Duration: Approximately 4 hours' and also 'Duration: 6 Hours'; used 6 hours from the trip name. No prices on the site. Round-trip transport listed as available for an additional fee.

trips.title: 8 Hour Fishing Trip
trips.summary: A full day offshore for big game fish, starting early in the morning. Lunch, fruit and local snacks are served on board, and the boat has an air-conditioned salon and a restroom with shower.
highlights: Targets blue marlin, yellowfin tuna, sailfish, wahoo and mahi-mahi
includes: Full onboard lunch, snacks, fruit, and local treats
Comfortable seating, air-conditioned salon, restroom with shower
trips.checkNotes: Departure: 'Early morning preferred', no set time. The 'Ideal for' line on the Trips page is placeholder Latin text; the home page says it suits serious anglers, big-game enthusiasts and private groups. No prices on the site. Round-trip transport available for an additional fee.

trips.title: Tournament Fishing Charters
trips.summary: Packages for anglers who want to fish regional tournaments around the Caribbean on board Legacy. Gear, live bait, meals and drinks are covered for the days of the event.
highlights: Targets blue marlin, yellowfin tuna, sailfish, wahoo and mahi-mahi
includes: Full onboard lunch, snacks, fruit, and local treats
Comfortable seating, air-conditioned salon, restroom with shower
trips.checkNotes: No tournament names, dates or prices on the site. The only photo in this block is a generic theme image (destination-usa.jpg), left out. Departure point for tournaments outside Barbados not stated; Careenage is the site-wide departure point.
